The “battle at Choo Hoey’s birthplace” refers to the Allied raids on Palembang (the winter‑war “Operation Meridian”) in early 1945.  
The first raid took place on 24 January 1945, and the second – which effectively ended the operation – occurred on **29 January 1945**. Thus, the battle concluded on 29 January 1945.
